faq.a: Exact dates for Marbella Pride 2027 are usually announced in early spring. Historically, the event runs over a long weekend in late June, with the main parade on Saturday. We recommend checking the official Marbella Pride website for confirmed dates, and booking your yacht charter as soon as they're released.

faq.q: Can I depart from Cabopino Marina for Pride?
faq.a: Yes, all our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, which is a 15-minute drive from Cabopino Marina. We can arrange a taxi or transfer from Cabopino to Puerto Banús for a small fee. Alternatively, you can drive and park at Puerto Banús (paid parking available).

faq.q: How many people can I bring on a Pride charter?
faq.a: Our fleet ranges from 5 to 12 passengers. For smaller groups (up to 5), the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 are ideal. For up to 10-12 guests, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Mangusta 80, or Ferretti 94. Check each boat's max capacity in our fleet list.

faq.q: What's included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. For Tier B boats (Mangusta 80), a jet ski is included free for 4+ hour bookings.

faq.q: How much does a Pride yacht charter cost?
faq.a: Prices start at €749 for 2 hours (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) is €4,719 minimum for 4 hours. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Contact us for a custom quote.

faq.q: Can we play our own music on the yacht?
faq.a: Absolutely. All our yachts are equipped with Bluetooth or AUX sound systems. Bring your own Pride playlist and we'll keep the volume at a respectful level for the marina. For larger parties, some boats have premium sound systems—ask when booking.

faq.q: What's the best time of day for a Pride charter?
faq.a: Afternoon charters (2-6 PM) are popular for catching the pre-parade buzz. Sunset cruises (6-9 PM) offer golden light and cooler temps. If you want to watch the parade from the water, a late-afternoon departure works well. Book early to secure your preferred slot.

faq.q: Is there a dress code for the yacht?
faq.a: No strict dress code, but we recommend smart-casual. Deck shoes or non-marking soles are best. Bring a light jacket for evening breezes, and don't forget sunscreen. Pride colours and glitter are welcome—just avoid high heels on deck.

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2027 is set to be the Costa del Sol's most vibrant celebration of diversity, and there's no better way to join the festivities than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from Cabopino Marina (via nearby Puerto Banús), our fleet offers exclusive charters for 5 to 12 guests, with prices starting at just €749 for 2 hours. Whether you want to cruise the coastline before the parade or anchor near the action, we make it seamless. Secure your boat now—Pride charters sell out fast.

Why charter a yacht for Marbella Pride 2027?

Marbella Pride draws thousands to the Golden Mile and Puerto Banús each year. A private yacht gives you front-row seats to the parade from the water, avoids crowded beach clubs, and lets you celebrate with your own group in comfort. You control the music, the drinks, and the itinerary. Plus, with a skipper handling navigation, you can focus on having fun.

Cabopino Marina departure: what to expect

Cabopino Marina is a charming, less crowded alternative to Puerto Banús, located just 15 minutes east of Marbella centre. While our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, we arrange easy transfers from Cabopino. You'll be on the water within 20 minutes. The marina itself has parking, restaurants, and a small beach—ideal for a pre-charter coffee.

Our fleet for Pride 2027

We offer 17 boats, from speedy open bows to luxury flybridges. All include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Here's a quick overview:

Sample Pride 2027 itinerary

  • 14:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.
  • 14:30 – Depart towards Cabopino coast. Swim stop at Cala del Faro.
  • 16:00 – Cruise back via Marbella's Golden Mile. Light snacks served.
  • 17:30 – Anchor near Puerto Banús for parade views from the water.
  • 19:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark for evening events.

Custom itineraries are available—just ask when booking.

Pricing and booking for Pride 2027

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Tier B (Mangusta 80) is €4,719 minimum for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. To secure your preferred date, we recommend booking at least 4-6 weeks in advance. Contact us on WhatsApp for availability and custom quotes.

What's included in every charter

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

No hidden extras. Just show up and celebrate.

Nearby attractions for Pride 2027

After your charter, explore Cabopino's dune beach, dine at Chiringuito El Cabopino, or head to Marbella's Old Town for the Pride after-party. Puerto Banús itself offers world-class shopping and nightlife. For a quieter evening, Sotogrande is a 20-minute drive south.
